_comment: EXAMPLE — paint protocol (FICTIONAL BYTE LAYOUT, do not import against real hardware without capturing your own traffic). Shows the shape of a working paint section: report id 6, 64-byte report, a 2-byte prefix, and 20 repeated RGB slots. Delete this comment key if you adapt the file — the validator ignores unknown keys.
name: Example OEM mouse (paint)
author: FullRGB maintainers (example file — capture your own traffic first)
notes: Write is triple-gated: the global 'Experimental writes' switch AND a typed double confirmation are required for every single test paint. Start read-only: ship the probe, collect report bytes, and only add a paint section once a report deterministically mirrors the vendor software's colours.
source: shape based on common Sino Wealth OEM boards — NOT verified on this PID
